title: 1000 brightest records from HYG 4.1 (Sun excluded)
attribution: HYG Database v4.1, David Nash / Astronexus; derived selection and B−V temperature estimates for Shanghai park sky.
temperatureMethod: Ballesteros (2012), approximate color temperature from B−V; not a measured effective temperature. Null when missing/outside range.
selection: 1000 lowest apparent visual magnitudes; retain catalog components; exclude Sol. No invented stars.
